quantitative_conclusions: R500-R400 best: all three paired AbsRel differences improve, mean -0.00063997(about0.67% relative), but scene CI[-0.00144941,0.00010661] crosses zero. RMSE -0.00222218 also improves all seeds with CI crossing zero. Delta1 +0.00165335 CI[0.00021974,0.00331379] improves all three.

R500-R400 best F1 -0.00108730 CI[-0.00224540,0.00010784] crosses zero; seed differences +0.00781483/-0.00549064/-0.00558611. Band AbsRel -0.00011732 also crosses zero, with one worse/two better seeds. More data gives no robust boundary-detection gain here.

R500-R400 final AbsRel -0.00078325 CI[-0.00160508,-0.00005887] and delta1 +0.00186212 CI[0.00030715,0.00356908] improve all three seeds. RMSE -0.00345043, F1 -0.00065599 and band +0.00006543 have CIs crossing zero. Final F1 changes also have one gain/two losses.

R500-B0 best and final improve AbsRel/RMSE/delta1/band AbsRel in all seeds, with scene intervals excluding zero. Best differences: -0.02606489/-0.05589818/+0.05942385/-0.02760758 respectively. F1 best -0.00170073 CI[-0.00518807,0.00208121] and final -0.00189722 CI[-0.00543892,0.00194875] cross zero; one seed improves and two worsen.

Final-best group differences: AbsRel +0.00018615, RMSE +0.00148916, delta1 -0.00017124, F1 -0.00019649, band -0.00002161; all scene intervals cross zero. Best/final identity of seed113 contributes an exact zero, not an independent replication.

This final three-seed result supersedes the provisional first-seed F1 benefit/band penalty and the two-seed final-F1 interval excluding zero. Original observations are retained as interim evidence, not silently overwritten.

qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0226: Both substantially reduce B0 large wall/person/sofa scale error. Final further improves AbsRel0.3065->0.2934, a positive endpoint example. F1 stays about0.511, with nearly identical person/column/sofa contours and persistent displaced branches/missed furniture.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0246: Final worsens broad surface values, AbsRel0.1178->0.1277; both slightly or clearly worse than B0 0.1129. Foreground cyan silhouette is preserved, F1 barely changes0.518->0.516. False ceiling edge and missed narrow shelf structures persist.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0080: Both improve B0 overall depth but reduce its already sparse boundary detection. Final AbsRel0.0861->0.0890, F1 0.134->0.118 and predicted edges100->88. A few cyan shelf fragments shrink while most GT edges remain red. This is a limited local regression, not a constant output or full disappearance.

interpretation: R500 modestly improves overall depth over R400, with stronger evidence at the stopping endpoint than at the selected best. Its endpoints are stable under the fixed rule, but boundary F1 is seed-dependent and not improved overall. Fixed pictures mainly show surface-depth correction with unresolved thin/missing boundaries. Same-count L/J/S results are still needed before route comparison.
